#final Renovoderm paper processing for ITS analysis

```{r}
#Activate
library(qiime2R)
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tibble)
library(decontam)
library (BiocManager)
```

#upload data
```{r}
#create phyloseq objects
F_ps_raw <- qza_to_phyloseq(
   features = "C:/Projects/Renovoderm/files/otu_table_ITS.qza", 
  taxonomy = "C:/Projects/Renovoderm/files/Taxonomy_table_ITS.qza", 
  metadata = "C:/Projects/Renovoderm/files/Renovoderm_metadata_clean.txt")

#check 
print(F_ps_raw)

#view each phyloseq object
tax_table = as.data.frame(tax_table(F_ps_raw))
meta_table = as.data.frame(sample_data(F_ps_raw))
otu_table = as.data.frame(otu_table(F_ps_raw))
```

#Confirm that all samples found are fungi
```{r}
ps_fungi<-F_ps_raw

#access the taxa table
F_taxonomy <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_fungi))

#keep only taxa identified as Fungi
F_taxonomy_filtered <-subset(F_taxonomy, Kingdom == "Fungi")

#check the updated data
unique <- length(unique(F_taxonomy_filtered$Kingdom))
unique
head(F_taxonomy_filtered)

#update the table in the phyloseq object
tax_table(ps_fungi) <- as.matrix(F_taxonomy_filtered)

print("percent of features remaining")
sum(rowSums(otu_table(ps_fungi)))/sum(rowSums(otu_table(F_ps_raw)))

ps_fungi

#check incertae counts 
incertae_counts <- colSums(apply(F_taxonomy_filtered, 2, function(column) grepl("Incertae", column)))
incertae_counts
```

#Format Taxonomy Table 
```{r}
F_tax_ps<-ps_fungi

#remove Incertae
no_incer_i<-tax_table(F_tax_ps)

#count initial NA's 
print("initial NA's")
sum(is.na(no_incer_i))

#assign NA to incertae
no_incer <- no_incer_i
no_incer[grepl("Incertae", no_incer)]<-NA

#count NA's to verify Incertae replaced
print("incertae removed")
sum(is.na(no_incer))-sum(is.na(no_incer_i))

#Remove _sp from Species labels 
no_sp<-no_incer
no_sp[grepl("_sp", no_sp)]<-NA

#count final NA's to see how many species changed
print("_sp removed")
sum(is.na(no_sp))-sum(is.na(no_incer))

#Update phyloseq
tax_table(F_tax_ps)<-no_sp
```
#view if top features across samples are identified
```{r}
#isolate otu table
feature_counts <- as.data.frame(otu_table(F_tax_ps))

#count cells in rows with values greater than zero(i.e how many samples have that feature)
clean_row <- rowSums(feature_counts >0)

#organize into descending order
ordered_features <- clean_row[order(-clean_row)]

#check data
ordered_features

#convert to dataframe
counts_df <- data.frame(sample_counts = ordered_features)

#view df
counts_df

#isolate taxonomy data
tax_data <- data.frame(tax_table(F_tax_ps))

#merge taxonomy table and feature counts
all_feature_count <- merge(tax_data,counts_df, by="row.names", all=TRUE)

#rename first column header
colnames(all_feature_count)[1] <"OTU_ID"

#remove NA
c_feature_count <- all_feature_count %>% filter(!is.na(sample_counts))

#organize in descending order
clean_feature_counts <- c_feature_count[order(-c_feature_count$sample_counts),]

#check samples
clean_feature_counts
```

#update genus
```{r}
F_ps_updated <- F_tax_ps

#create otu-to-genus mapping data frame
F_otu_to_genus<-data.frame(
  OTU_ID = c("cd03d9995e038d2cdf303ff5fde7bc95", "c7877d5015269e991650902c81aadd03", "b4527a1f995e88625897716b04cbe000", "1d5d79472c70d47782eb1e838c364e6c", "5b4929c242f73d0819939a655ded92b5", "8433a1c354b80e31f5f46e923322b101", "f87625f97225472e0bada2c834865d92", "3cbbfa93f9e5f238208ef480f2dba971", "0fc8f3c8285d1ea5bd0bc904bc1ac0cf", "744eb40a3c3ae47fe8b01edfa8f34711"), 
  Genus = c("o_Polyporales", "f_Cystobasidiaceae", "f_Microdochiaceae", "c_Agaricomycetes", "p_Ascomycota", "c_Dothideomycetes", "Trichomerium", "Candida", "c_Microbotryomycetes", "Rigidoporus")) 

#extract the taxonomy table from the phyloseq object
tax_table_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(F_ps_updated))

#update the Genus column based on the OTU-to-Genus mapping
tax_table_df$Genus <- ifelse(
  rownames(tax_table_df) %in% F_otu_to_genus$OTU_ID, 
  F_otu_to_genus$Genus[match(rownames(tax_table_df), F_otu_to_genus$OTU_ID)], 
  tax_table_df$Genus)

#replace the updated taxonomy table in the phyloseq object
tax_table(F_ps_updated) <- as.matrix(tax_table_df)

#view the updated taxonomy table for the specific OTUs
tax_table_df[F_otu_to_genus$OTU_ID, ]

F_ps_updated
```

#View distribution of taxonomic identification
```{r}
F_unidentified_taxa <- tax_table(F_ps_updated)

#count total identified at each taxonomic rank
identified <-colSums(!is.na(F_unidentified_taxa))

#make new df with identified counts at each rank
labeled_counts<-data.frame(Identified = identified)
F_taxonomy_set<- rownames_to_column(labeled_counts, var="Taxonomy Level")
F_taxonomy_set

#extract value for "Kingdom" in the "Identified" column for total
total<-F_taxonomy_set$Identified[F_taxonomy_set$`Taxonomy Level` =="Kingdom"]

#calculate percent of identified taxa at each level, relative to kingdom level
x<-F_taxonomy_set$Identified
F_taxonomy_set$`Percent Identified`<- x/total*100

#set order in taxonomic level column
F_taxonomy_set$`Taxonomy Level`<-factor(F_taxonomy_set$`Taxonomy Level`, levels = c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species"))

#plot results
F_taxonomy_graph <- ggplot(F_taxonomy_set, aes(x=`Taxonomy Level`, y=`Percent Identified`))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="steelblue")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(title = "Percent of features identified at each taxonomic level", x= "Taxonomic Level", y= "Percent Identified")+
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = -90))
F_taxonomy_graph
```
#remove empty samples and low abundant taxa (FILTER BY COUNTS METHOD) 
```{r}
F_remove_empty1_ps<-F_ps_updated

#isolate otu table
otu_table<-otu_table(F_remove_empty1_ps)

#remove very low abundant features (those with 5 or less counts)
clean_otu1<-otu_table[rowSums(otu_table)>5,]

#view empty samples (won't run when no empty samples)
empty_samples<-clean_otu1[,colSums(clean_otu1)<1]
colnames(empty_samples)

#remove empty samples
clean_otu2<- clean_otu1[,colSums(clean_otu1)>0]

#look at feature and sample distribution
print("feature counts distribution")
summary(rowSums(clean_otu2))

print("feature counts in samples distribution")
summary(colSums(clean_otu2))

#update phyloseq
otu_table(F_remove_empty1_ps)<-clean_otu2
F_remove_empty1_ps
```

#Filter out contaminants
```{r}
#separate metadata
F_filter_ps <- F_remove_empty1_ps
sample_data<-sample_data(F_filter_ps)

#change all negative controls to "Neg"
sample_data$Subject_id<-gsub("NEG", "Neg",sample_data$Subject_id)

#update phyloseq object
sample_data(F_filter_ps)<-sample_data

#identify negative controls and creates an "is.neg column
sample_data(F_filter_ps)$is.neg <- sample_data(F_filter_ps)$Subject_id == "Neg"

#filter contaminants based on prevalence in negative controls in comparison to samples
F_contamdf.prev <- isContaminant(F_filter_ps, method = "prevalence", neg= "is.neg")

print("number of contaminant taxa")
table(F_contamdf.prev$contaminant)

#prune taxa to only contain non-contaminated sequences
print("after contaminant cleaning")
F_ps.noncontam <- prune_taxa(!F_contamdf.prev$contaminant, F_filter_ps)
F_ps.noncontam
```
#Vew contaminated taxa
```{r}
#Extract contaminant taxa (TRUE)
F_contaminants <- rownames(F_contamdf.prev[F_contamdf.prev$contaminant == TRUE, ])

#Extract taxonomy for contaminant taxa
F_contaminant_taxa <- tax_table(F_filter_ps)[F_contaminants, ]

#view counts of contaminants across samples before removal
names<-rownames(F_contaminant_taxa) 
count_present<-clean_otu2[rownames(clean_otu2) %in% names, ]
total_count_present<-rowSums(count_present)
total_count_present
summary(total_count_present)

#view taxonomy of contaminants
print("contaminant taxa")
F_contaminant_taxa
```
#remove negative and positive controls from analysis 
```{r}
#create new phyloseq object without negative controls
F_ps_clean <- prune_samples(sample_data(F_ps.noncontam)$Sex != "N/A", F_ps.noncontam)

#check resulting phyloseq object
no_controls <- sample_data(F_ps_clean)$Subject_id
no_controls

F_ps_clean
```
#Remove empty samples and features
```{r}
F_remove_empty2_ps <- F_ps_clean

#remove empty samples 
F_remove_empty2_ps <- prune_samples(sample_sums(F_remove_empty2_ps) >0, F_remove_empty2_ps)

#extract OTU table
otu <- otu_table(F_remove_empty2_ps)

#check with zeros removed
print("Zero Count Before Removal")
sum(rowSums(otu)<1)

#remove features (rows) with 0 counts
otu_clean <- otu[rowSums(otu)>0,]

#update ps object
otu_table(F_remove_empty2_ps) <- otu_clean
F_remove_empty2_ps
```

#Prepare for normalization
#check if sample types have different sampling depths
```{r}
F_ps_counts<-F_sample_analysis

#extract otu table and sum total counts
otu_counts<-otu_table(F_ps_counts)

#sum feature count for each sample
total_counts<-colSums(otu_counts)
summary(total_counts)

#combine metadata with total counts
metadata<-sample_data(F_ps_counts)
metadata$counts<-total_counts

#make sure counts are numeric
metadata$counts<-as.numeric(metadata$counts)

#list comparisons for wilcox test
comparisons<- list(c("Intact_skin","Wound"))

#visualize difference in counts
F_swab_type_counts<-ggplot(metadata, aes(x=Swab_type, y=counts, fill=Swab_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(title = "Swab type count Distribution", x = "Swab_type", y = "Total Counts", fill="Swab_type")+
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox",
                     label = "p.signif",
                     size = 4,
                    comparisons = comparisons)
F_swab_type_counts
```

#prep otu table
```{r}
F_ps_all_samples<-F_sample_analysis

#isolate OTU table
otus<-as.matrix(otu_table(F_ps_all_samples))

#flip otu table (sample IDs as row names and OTU IDs as column headers)
flipped_otu<-t(otus)
flipped_clean_otus<-as.data.frame(flipped_otu)
flipped_clean_otus

#generate rarefaction curves
vegan::rarecurve(flipped_clean_otus, step = 5, col = "blue", cex = 0.5, label =TRUE, ylim =c(0,100), xlim =c(0,1200))
```

#rarefaction (do not re-run or will re-subsample)
```{r}
#switch columns and header names
df_matrix <- as.matrix(clean_otu_c)
c_flipped_clean_otu <- t(df_matrix)
c_flipped_clean_otu<-as.data.frame(c_flipped_clean_otu)

#check changes
c_flipped_clean_otu

#determine the minimum total number of individuals
min_sample_size<- min(rowSums(c_flipped_clean_otu))
min_sample_size

#generate multiple rarefied OTU table (3 different sub-samples)
F_rarefied_otu_data1 <- vegan::rrarefy(c_flipped_clean_otu, min_sample_size)
F_rarefied_otu_data2 <- vegan::rrarefy(c_flipped_clean_otu, min_sample_size)
F_rarefied_otu_data3 <- vegan::rrarefy(c_flipped_clean_otu, min_sample_size)
```

#cleaned data(not normalized)
#add number to all NA genus
```{r}
genus_unknown <- F_remove_empty2_ps

#extract taxonomy table from phyloseq object
tax_table_cleaned <- as.data.frame(tax_table(genus_unknown))

#add a unique number to NA values in Genus column
tax_table_cleaned$Genus[is.na(tax_table_cleaned$Genus)] <- paste("Unknown_genus", seq_along(tax_table_cleaned$Genus[is.na(tax_table_cleaned$Genus)]), sep="_")

#update taxonomy table
tax_table(genus_unknown)<-as.matrix(tax_table_cleaned)

#filter only unique genus names
F_unique_genus<-tax_glom(genus_unknown, taxrank="Genus")
F_unique_genus
```
